text: 欧委会贸易和经济安全委员谢夫乔维奇将访问北京。 今年6月，中欧已经建立贸易投资磋商机制，下设贸易和投资平衡、出口管制、知识产权、世贸组织改革四个工作板块。（玉渊谭天）
text_en: European Commission Trade and Economic Security Commissioner Šefčovič will visit Beijing. In June this year, China and the EU already established a trade and investment consultation mechanism, with four working areas: trade and investment balance, export controls, intellectual property rights, and WTO reform. (Yuyuantantian)
